column3: With respect to the Market Place Center Mortgage Loan (8.7%), the largest tenant, Universal Services of America, the right to terminate its lease any time after March 1, 2026 if the sponsor reduces the contracted billable guard service hours provided by Tenant by more than 50% over the hours billed for the trailing 12 months prior to December 2021, with 6 months’ prior notice and payment of termination fee equal to equal to 2 months of base rent plus unamortized TI/LC.
